newsitem.title: USA: Emons preliminary count shows record year.
newsitem.headline: Emons preliminary count shows record year.

text.p: Emons Transportation Group Inc on Wednesday said preliminary results for fiscal 1997 show the company handled record numbers of freight carloads and intermodal trailers and containers.
The company said carloads of freight handled during the year ended June 30 rose 7 percent to 37,000. Intermodal trailers and containers transported rose 50 percent to 12,900.

In the fourth quarter, the company handled 9,400 carloads, or 7 percent more than in the year-earlier quarter. Trailers and containers rose 46 percent to 3,300 from the fourth quarter of the previous year.
The company will report its financial results in early September, Chairman Robert Grossman said. He declined to provide any details on expected results.

The freight transportation and distribution services company, based in York, Pennsylvania, serves the mid-Atlantic and Northeast regions of the United States. It owns three short-line/regional railroads, operates rail/truck transfer and warehouse facilities and a rail intermodal terminal. It also provides logistics services.

Also on Wednesday the company said about 1,426,000 shares of its common stock and 586,000 shares of its convertible preferred stock will be released from escrow. The escrow was created in 1986 as part of a Chapter 11 reorganization plan of its Emons Industries Inc subsidiary.
Emons said the shares released from escrow will be distributed to about 700 holders who were claimants. The company has 5,800,624 common shares outstanding and 1,650,857 preferred shares outstanding.
